xmldoc.short_description: List models available from an AI provider.

description.p: aimodels returns the available model names for a configured AI provider.
For Ollama, aimodels calls the local /api/tags endpoint derived from the endpoint stored in options. The default endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags.
For OpenAI-compatible providers, aimodels calls /v1/models derived from the configured endpoint and uses TokenEnvVar as a bearer token when provided.
The first output is a cell array of model names. The optional second output is the raw provider response.

example_item.example_item_description: Use the first available Ollama model with aiask.
example_item.example_item_data: models = aimodels(); opts = aioptions('Provider', 'ollama', ... 'Model', models{1}, ... 'SystemPrompt', 'Return only Nelson code. Nelson functions use syntax: function y = name(x), statements, end.', ... 'Think', false, ... 'NumPredict', 120, ... 'Temperature', 0); answer = aiask('Write function y = vector_mean(x). Use y = mean(x).', opts)

example_item.example_item_description: Use a known local Ollama model.
example_item.example_item_data: opts = aioptions('Provider', 'ollama', ... 'Model', 'gemma4:latest', ... 'SystemPrompt', 'Return only Nelson code. Nelson functions use syntax: function y = name(x), statements, end.', ... 'Think', false, ... 'NumPredict', 120, ... 'Temperature', 0); answer = aiask('Write function y = vector_mean(x). Use y = mean(x).', opts)

example_item.example_item_description: List models from an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint.
List models from an OpenAI-compatible endpoint requiring a token.
example_item.example_item_data: % Define MY_AI_TOKEN in the environment before starting Nelson. opts = aioptions('Provider', 'openai-compatible', ... 'Endpoint', 'https://example.local/v1/chat/completions', ... 'TokenEnvVar', 'MY_AI_TOKEN', ... 'Timeout', 30); models = aimodels(opts)
